**Implementation note:** The W-bottom permission gate is wired (hf_entry_gated bounce_gate=w_bottom); plain band reversion is not.

## Description

Fade price excursions outside volatility bands when the strategy expects re-entry toward the moving average.

## Where it may fit

Stable, range-bound periods with temporary price shocks rather than fresh breakouts.

## Vehicles

Stocks, ETFs, FX, futures, crypto.

## Required data

OHLC/close, rolling mean and standard deviation, volume/spread, costs.

## Caveats

A band touch is not evidence that the move will reverse; band-walks occur in trends.
